notes.title: Build System changes coming soon
notes.notes: Hello, Well launch doesn't go as I anticipated, Many problems were about build system. I was working fitness/gym tycoon kinda game while working on anime tycoon. They both share the same building algorithm, due to your feedback I made changes in it to make build system more accessible. The best part is as both share the same algorithm it is possible to rollback changes from its system to anime tycoon. I already integrated few but I also need to make sure that it doesn't break savefile. I still need a few more days but I'm sure it will look much better with the new system.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello, I made some changes which will make the game easier to play and more balanced at the start.
[list]
[*] Increased Subcontract payment.
[*] Now there's no restriction while remodelling rooms.
[*] Improved inner working of employee's points generation and now it is more synced with speed. 
[*] Fixed issue in the room.
[*] Fixed issue when morale goes negative.
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, This update is specifically aimed to make the game less hard at easy difficulty. Also, it improves points generation when you are working on a script or other misc things. Let me know if it solves your issues with bankruptcy. Also, I'm writing a guide few sections are done and other's will be done soon. If you are having any problem refer to it or post on the forum.

[list]
[*] Improves payment from Subcontract.
[*] After the contract gets finished you won't get a notification that you earn money, You will get it only if you are the publisher of an anime.
[*] The improved working speed of employees.
[*] Improved the review algorithm.
[*] Story room sometimes don't close popup.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: UI Update and Demo
notes.notes: Hello, Last week I updated most of the in-game UI, even though the new video is not uploaded yet with UI but I am working to finish demo build for interested players first as making a simple video takes too much time. About the demo, I am planning it to release it mid next week demo will allow you to play the first few years of the game. I am making feedback and suggestions threads on the forum so please let me know if you encounter any bug or have any suggestion to improve the game.
